title: The First Thing His Heart Knows: Allah (Ages 2-3)
description: A 4-lesson path for the two- and three-year-old: at this age he imitates rather than reasons, so his aqeedah is the first words and the first tones — the name of Allah, «Bismillah» and «Alhamdulillah», that Allah loves him, and the Prophet's name ﷺ said with love.

primary_reference.info: ثلاثة الأصول لابن عثيمين، منهج التربية النبوية للطفل لمحمد نور سويد
